cards.title: TAVERN BROKER
cards.concept: tavern deal-broker in a grey leather vest over a rolled-sleeve linen shirt, arms crossed with a knowing half-smile, a fat coin pouch and a folded contract tucked at his chest.
cards.hook: Chief Business Officer and sales leader: the guy in the corner booth who closes every deal in the room.

cards.title: SELLSWORD
cards.concept: rugged sellsword in a padded grey gambeson with a leather shoulder strap, arms crossed, a plain longsword hilt rising behind one shoulder.
cards.hook: His signature arms-crossed, tough-but-warm stance from the team photo: hired steel you are glad is on your side.

cards.title: PLAID LUMBERJACK
cards.concept: cheerful woodcutter in a grey-checked flannel shirt with rolled sleeves and suspenders, a woodsman's axe resting over his shoulder behind his head.
cards.hook: The plaid shirt he wears in his photo, plus a pun: he cuts deals the way a lumberjack cuts timber.

cards.title: QUARTERMASTER
cards.concept: fort quartermaster in a plain grey tunic and leather apron, a quill behind his ear, a thick supply ledger and an iron ring of storeroom keys held at his chest.
cards.hook: His operations background: the one who keeps the whole company stocked, counted and running.

cards.title: DICE MERCHANT
cards.concept: market-stall game seller in a grey cloth smock with a knotted neck scarf, proudly holding up a wooden tray of carved dice and game tokens at chest height.
cards.hook: Xsolla, where he led acquisitions and launches for a video-game commerce company: he has always been in the business of selling games.

cards.title: MARKET SCOUT
cards.concept: pathfinder in a green hooded travelling cloak thrown back off his head, a brass spyglass raised near his chest and a rolled trade map slung behind his shoulder.
cards.hook: Strategic business development: always first to spot the next market worth expanding into.

cards.title: FALCON ENVOY
cards.concept: envoy in a green-trimmed leather jerkin with a heavy gauntlet, a small hooded messenger falcon perched on his shoulder clutching a sealed letter.
cards.hook: Strategic partnerships: his familiar carries the first message that opens every alliance.

cards.title: GUILD RECRUITER
cards.concept: guild recruiter in a green tabard with a new guild's crest, holding an unrolled recruitment charter at his chest with a confident, welcoming grin.
cards.hook: At Xsolla he stood up new departments from scratch: he builds the team before he builds the empire.

cards.title: WOLF TAMER
cards.concept: beast tamer in green-stitched fur-lined leathers, arms crossed, a bright-eyed young wolf pup peeking over his shoulder from behind his head.
cards.hook: He scales high-growth companies: raise the pup right and it grows into the pack leader; tough-but-warm, exactly like him.

cards.title: CARAVAN MASTER
cards.concept: caravan master in a long travel coat with teal trim and a high collar, a teal-glowing brass compass in one hand and a leather map case strapped across his chest.
cards.hook: Operations at scale: he gets the whole caravan, goods and people, across the desert on time.

cards.title: GUILD NEGOTIATOR
cards.concept: master negotiator in a tailored teal-accented doublet, extending a steel gauntlet for a firm handshake while holding a pact sealed with softly glowing teal wax.
cards.hook: Strategic partnerships and deal-making: his handshake is a binding contract.

cards.title: LOOT KNIGHT
cards.concept: knight in fitted silver plate with teal enamel trim, a kite shield emblazoned with a glowing teal treasure-chest crest held at his chest, visor raised to show his confident face.
cards.hook: At Xsolla he helped game studios sell their in-game loot: in a loot-box game, he is the knight who guards the treasure.

cards.title: MERCHANT PRINCE
cards.concept: merchant prince in violet-and-magenta brocade with a jewelled collar, enchanted contracts and cut gems orbiting him on violet runic light, eyes glinting with magic.
cards.hook: Sales and revenue growth: a prince whose treaties literally float into place.

cards.title: CLAN UNIFIER
cards.concept: warlord in ornate violet-runed plate, arms crossed, as several clan banners behind his shoulders twist together into one blazing magenta standard.
cards.hook: M&A: he led acquisitions at Xsolla, turning many houses into a single stronger realm.

cards.title: DRAGON KINGMAKER
cards.concept: ascended kingmaker in gold-and-white dragon-scale regalia, arms crossed in his signature stance, a colossal golden dragon coiled behind his shoulders with wings spread like a radiant halo, a ring of glowing allied-kingdom crests orbiting him.
cards.hook: His ultimate form as the builder and scaler of companies: the dealmaker who does not wear the crown but decides who does, guarding a hoard of every deal he ever closed.
